digest.component_or_area: Module size governance and code structure
propositions: Six modules sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap, blocking incoming work; llm/config.py (793 LOC, 7 lines headroom) cannot accommodate d23e's deprecation alias without structural relief
High-churn, high-centrality files like llm/config.py (16 commits per 400, 93 fan-in) must be relieved preemptively using the absorbing-verb / flat-table / colocated-domain shapes proven by ADR 0056
Relieved modules require seam tests with per-file headroom assertions (e.g. < 700 for config.py) as a structural substitute for the rejected per-function length gate
All four child tickets must land with zero edits to existing tests beyond mandatory headroom tightenings, and every relocation must satisfy the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor
gen_env_registry.py has a found defect: _llm_float is invisible to the scanner and must be registered in docs/env-vars.md
Every uses: entry in gates/plan-review.yaml must resolve in STEP_REGISTRY via a static test that does not exist at any layer today
